references.text: The Angel of the Lord appears to Moses in a burning bush, as a manifestation of God's presence.
The Angel of the Lord appears to Balaam, standing on the road as a warning.
The Angel of the Lord appears to Gideon under an oak tree and calls him to save Israel.
The Angel of the Lord appears to Manoah's wife, predicting the birth of Samson.
Psalm 99 highlights the Lord's holy presence among His people, parallel to the angel's holy presence in the temple.
The vision of the Lord seated on a high and lofty throne, with seraphim standing around Him, reflects the divine manifestation.
The Angel of the Lord rolls back the stone from Jesus' tomb and sits upon it, as a manifestation of God's power.
The Angel of God appears to Cornelius, a Gentile, as a sign that the gospel is also for the Gentiles.
